plotEn: The Doll (Polish: Lalka) is a 2026 Polish period romantic drama film directed by Maciej Kawalski and written by Kawalski and Łukasz Światowiec. The film is an adaptation of the novel The Doll by Bolesław Prus, widely regarded as one of the greatest works of Polish literature. It is the second adaptation after the 1968 film.
